tools.name: prompt-injection
tools.description: Prompt-injection check ($0.004 via x402 at POST https://sml-agent-products.onrender.com/agent-safety/v1/prompt-injection). POST {text}. Verdict safe/suspicious/malicious + score + categories + matched spans + obfuscation tricks found + recommendation.

tools.name: url-safety
tools.description: URL safety check ($0.004 via x402 at GET https://sml-agent-products.onrender.com/agent-safety/v1/url-safety). GET ?url=. Verdict safe/suspicious/dangerous + score + reasons (lookalike, brand impersonation, domain age, redirects, seed-phrase/drainer content, agent-targeted injection).

tools.name: x402-health
tools.description: x402 endpoint health / pay-readiness ($0.002 via x402 at GET https://sml-agent-products.onrender.com/agent-safety/v1/x402-health). GET ?url=&method=GET|POST&maxUsd=. Live probe (never pays): go/caution/no_go, recommended payment option, every accepts problem, discovery + bazaar metadata, latency.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Machine-readable catalog with prices and 402 terms

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prompt-injection, url-safety, x402-health · Public sink: prompt-injection, x402-health.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prompt-injection, url-safety, x402-health · Public sink: prompt-injection, x402-health

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
